talents.name: Wand Specialization
descriptions:

Higher chance to trigger than Wand Specialization (Rank 1).

talents.name: Enlighten
descriptions: Bring a party member under your tutelage for 30 min. Whenever you cast a Discipline or Holy spell, you have a 10% chance with helpful spells, or 15% chance with harmful spells, to burn them for 4% of their total health as Holy damage and increase both your and their spell damage and healing by 10% for 8 sec.  If cast on yourself, the spell damage and healing bonus is increased to 15%.  Only one party member can be under your tutelage at a time.

Cannot be used on allies with less than 80% health or below level 35.
